name: YITAMOTOR 1999-2002 Chevy Silverado GMC Sierra 1500/2500/3500 Rear Brake Tail Light
fitment:
1999-2002 Chevrolet Silverado 1500/2500
2001-2002 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 HD/2500 HD/3500
1999-2003 GMC Sierra 1500/2500
2001-2003 GMC Sierra 1500 HD/2500 HD/3500
Does Not Fit Stepside Models
Professional installation would be highly recommended
warnings: 官网质保弹窗引用其他品牌
description:
Night driving can be pretty tricky, especially with broken tail lights. Not only is such a situation inconvenient, but it can also be dangerous. To avoid potential accidents, please replace your tail lights when necessary. Upgrade your vehicle with a new, highly efficient set of YITAMOTOR lights to enjoy safer nighttime driving. Rest assured that drivers behind you will always be aware of when you're about to brake or turn.
Fitment
1999-2002 Chevrolet Silverado 1500/2500
2001-2002 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 HD/2500 HD/3500
1999-2003 GMC Sierra 1500/2500
2001-2003 GMC Sierra 1500 HD/2500 HD/3500
Does Not Fit Stepside Models
Professional installation would be highly recommended
Features
Direct OEM Fit
It's designed to be an exact replacement of your factory-installed tail lights.
Superior Aftermarket Replacement
Bulbs are not included, as stock bulbs should be reused; Sold in pairs with clear smoke lens; Provides exceptional illumination to increase driving safety.
Exclusive Custom Styling
DOT and SAE certified; Creative light and reflector layout achieve an attractive appearance.
Tougher-than-nails Construction
Heavy-duty housings are made of superior OEM Grade ABS plastic to ensure exceptional weather and impact resistance so they will serve you for years ahead.
Simple Plug and Play Installation
These bolt-on style tail lights are designed for quick and easy installation. There's no need for any modifications, they drop right into the factory location.
